meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications and the visual direction matters as much as the code quality.

copy.tagline: 构建高设计品质的前端界面与组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码质量与视觉设计之间取得平衡
copy.tagline_en: Build production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to balance code quality with visual design

howto.what: Claude 会先确定界面的目的、受众、情感基调等，然后构建视觉系统（字体、颜色、间距等），最后产出有明确设计风格的前端代码，避免通用AI风格的UI。
howto.when: 当你要求构建网页组件、页面或应用，且视觉质量与代码质量同等重要时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个产品落地页，风格要极简且有编辑感。
say.note: Claude会先分析需求，然后构建视觉系统并产出代码。

say.text: 把这个仪表盘界面升级一下，用工业风，强调排版和动效。
say.note: Claude会保留现有功能，重新设计视觉方向。

howto.what_en: Claude first frames the interface (purpose, audience, tone, direction), then builds a visual system (typography, color, spacing, motion), and finally produces production-grade frontend code with a clear design point of view, avoiding generic AI-looking UI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build web components, pages, or applications and the visual direction matters as much as the code quality.

say_en.text: Design a product landing page with a minimal, editorial style.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze requirements, build a visual system, and output code.

say_en.text: Upgrade this dashboard with an industrial look, emphasizing typography and motion.
say_en.note: Claude will retain functionality while redesigning the visual direction.
